authority.source: the owner's answers of 2026-11-09 in the planning session for issue #2303, revised after two second opinions: publish once, then everything updates by itself and the light says it; an updated graphic on air shows its new design at its next Take; a queued graphic is self-contained, takes a library design only through Update, and existing productions keep what is published; a Take never waits and is never blocked; send only what changed, publishing and saving alike, each image uploaded once, the migration is fine; 3 to 5 people at once; CasparCG 2.5 is the target; make no change that risks reliable playout; retire the hosted control page as a phase; separating the production page is a later plan only if proven safer or faster. Owner decisions D1 to D6 settled 2026-11-09: "All as recommended". Final after a third second opinion.
